decisions.reason: Removing exact spoken-script adherence does not independently alter the required gameplay demonstration sequence or make any of its attributes obsolete.
The source reports general script mismatch and cancellation but does not modify the independently specified phone-message opening action or placement.
Exact spoken-script adherence is independent of the requirement to use the same phone for the opening and gameplay demonstration.
The source does not change the video's Igbo-language or video-count attributes; script mismatch does not entail a language change.
Contract cancellation makes the duration-versus-script dispute practically moot but does not establish, remove, or select a duration rule, so no candidate MODIFY is entailed.
